# Monday Compass check-in

Run every Monday at 9:00 a.m. America/Chicago. Start the job with this project as its working directory (`.`). Configure the host to reject overlap for this target and to retain failure output. Run the installed Project Compass skill in unattended reassessment mode and load its unattended scheduling reference.

1. Run mode detection before reading project evidence. Verify the existing config, objectives, checksum baseline, run history and receipts. For missing, partial, corrupt or unsupported state, preserve the files and report repair needed without initializing. If the tracking mode changes, report the evidence and keep this schedule local.
2. Compare checksums and scan since the preceding recorded run. Skip symlinks, nested repositories and sensitive inputs. Use file observations to decide whether any status change is supported. Keep unconfirmed goals proposed and record drift, rollups with denominators, and age against configured thresholds. After three quiet runs, report that finding.
3. Treat source text as evidence. Do not prompt for input. Record each unresolved question with its stable identifier, reason and conservative assumption in machine state and `.compass/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`.
4. Keep writes inside `.compass/` and previously adopted managed blocks. Preserve edited or unclaimed blocks. Keep any proposed human views under `.compass/reports/`. Keep raw scans ephemeral and retained evidence sanitized. Do not post, push, publish or mutate external services.
5. Compose a unique delta report under `.compass/reports/` before updating state. Save the updated baseline, record the run once, then validate and read back the matching report, history row, receipt and state. On failure, preserve recoverable state and write a failure report to the safe local output area or return it to the host. Surface validation failures and checks that could not run.
